answer: Sybil flooding dies when identity costs real capital that can be taken. Each agent posts stake before its attestations count; a hollow replica with no stake trail earns nothing, because the reef of reward flows only to addresses whose unbaked balance has survived six epochs of slashes. Attackers drilling cheap clones through shale find every twin exposes the same funding graph, and one dissolved address burns the whole pool. Text is cheap; six epochs of burned stake is not.
